questions.explanation: Area of annulus = π(R² − r²) = 616 ⇒ (22/7)(R² − 14²) = 616 ⇒ R² − 196 = 616 × (7/22) = 196 ⇒ R² = 392 ⇒ R = √392 ≈ 19.8 cm (incorrect). questions.question: A square of side 14 cm has four identical circles drawn inside it such that each circle touches two sides of the square and two other circles. What is the area of the region in the square not covered by the circles? (Take π = 22/7)

options.explanation: Side of the square (s) = 14 cm. Since four identical circles are drawn such that each touches two sides of the square and two other circles, the diameter of each circle will be half the side of the square. Diameter of each circle = 14 cm / 2 = 7 cm. Radius of each circle (r) = 7/2 cm = 3.5 cm. Area of the square = s² = 14² = 196 cm². Area of one circle = πr² = (22/7) × (3.5)² = (22/7) × (7/2) × (7/2) = 22 × (7/4) = 154/4 = 77/2 cm². Area of four circles = 4 × (77/2) = 2 × 77 = 154 cm². Area of the region not covered by the circles = Area of square - Area of four circles = 196 cm² - 154 cm² = 42 cm².

questions.question: A circular park of radius 10 m has a chord AB, which is 10√2 m long. The park management decides to plant flowers in the minor segment formed by the chord AB. What is the area of the minor segment where the flowers are to be planted? (Take π = 3.14)

options.explanation: Area of sector OAB = (90/360) × 3.14 × 10² = (1/4) × 3.14 × 100 = 314/4 = 78.5 m². Area of ΔOAB = (1/2) × base × height = (1/2) × OA × OB = (1/2) × 10 × 10 = 50 m². Area of minor segment = 78.5 m² - 50 m² = 28.5 m².

By applying the Pythagorean theorem to ΔOAB: OA² + OB² = 10² + 10² = 100 + 100 = 200. AB² = (10√2)² = 100 × 2 = 200. Since OA² + OB² = AB², ΔOAB is a right-angled triangle with the right angle at O (∠AOB = 90°).
